_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 49 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 124,070 berths as of December 31, 2017'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2017 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 49 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 124,070 berths as of December 31, 2017'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2017 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 1.13x; +24% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.09; conservative 2yr +54%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.0%/yr (Q4 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.0%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2019-01-18) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.13x (93.6% downside to Bear $7 / +82.9% upside to Bull $200) | Adj composite 2.89 vs market 1.80: gap +1.09 [UNDERVALUED] | +24% above the EPP floor $88 (10x FY18E $8.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: +54.3% total (+27.2%/yr) | At 12.4x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $145 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields +1.8% in Q3 2018, forward net revenue +16.83-17.38% (Q4 2018 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
